transcript: Speaker A: लोग कहते हैं हिंदी मीडियम वाले का बेटा इंग्लिश क्या बोलेगा... [People say, 'How can a Hindi medium student's child speak English?'... on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority... [English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority...]
summary: An AI avatar addresses the social shame faced by Hindi-medium students who cannot speak English. She introduces herself as a non-judgmental AI coach on the English Seekho app where users can practice freely. The ad offers a trial for just 1 rupee and encourages downloading the app to earn respect.
